paragraphs.en: The Matsu Islands are an archipelago of 36 islands in the East China Sea, alongside the southeastern coast of mainland China. The islands have been administered since 1949 by Taiwan, part of a larger set of outlying islands administered by Taiwan, which includes the Kinmen and Penghu Islands, which all lie in the Taiwan Strait.

paragraphs.en: The Matsu Islands are connected to Taiwan’s main island by two submarine cables — Taima No.2 , Taima No.3 , and soon Taima No.4 . The Taiwan Strait is a shallow body of water, with an average depth of 70m. The submarine cables that lie on this seafloor are vulnerable to damage from ship-based activity, like being snagged by fishing equipment or anchors. But these particular cables have been remarkably unlucky. Between 2018 and 2022, the submarine cables between Taiwan and the Matsu Islands were cut 27 times, and there have been four major outages in the three years from 2023 to 2025.
paragraphs.zh: 马祖列岛通过两条海底电缆与台湾本岛相连——台马二号、台马三号，以及即将建成的台马四号。 台湾海峡是一片较浅的水域，平均深度为70米。 铺设在这片海底的海底电缆很容易受到船舶活动造成的损坏，比如被渔具或锚钩住。 但这几条电缆的遭遇格外不走运。 2018年至2022年间，台湾与马祖列岛之间的海底电缆被切断27次，而在2023年至2025年的三年里，已发生四次重大中断事故。

paragraphs.en: We regard this collection of submarine cable systems as critical infrastructure for global communication services, and we take care to make them as resilient as possible. paragraphs.en: On the night of 4 August 1914, days after Britain declared war against Germany, the British cable ship HMTS Alert sailed from Dover into the English Channel. The vessel dragged grappling hooks along the seabed, hauled up five German transatlantic and European telegraph cables, and cut them. This severed Germany’s direct, secure submarine cable links to the Americas, Africa, Spain, and the rest of Europe. Germany was forced to rely on wireless radio transmissions, where British intelligence could readily eavesdrop. If the German cryptography used to protect these wireless communications was broken, then it allowed the British to track military movements and capture critical messages, such as the Zimmermann Telegram. This same action to deliberately sever undersea cables was repeated by the British in September 1939, cutting German cables to Lisbon and New York.
paragraphs.zh: 1914年8月4日夜间，即英国对德国宣战数日后，英国海底电缆船HMTS Alert号从多佛驶入英吉利海峡。 该船在海底拖曳抓钩，钩起五条横跨大西洋及欧洲的德国电报电缆并将其切断。 此举切断了德国通往美洲、非洲、西班牙及欧洲其他地区的直接且安全的海底电缆链路。 德国被迫依赖无线电传输，而英国情报部门可以轻易窃听。 一旦用于保护这些无线通信的德国密码学被破译，英国便得以追踪军事动向并截获关键电文，例如齐默尔曼电报。 英国人于1939年9月重复了这种故意切断海底电缆的行动，切断了德国通往里斯本和纽约的电缆。

paragraphs.en: The cable surfaces at a cable landing station. These landing stations are typically plain, secured facilities with reliable power. The preferred location is a coastal point with a low volume of fishing or other maritime traffic, and a steep rise from the deep-sea floor. Cables are at their greatest risk from coastal shipping activity, so the shorter the distance from the deep-sea floor to the cable station on dry land, the better.
paragraphs.zh: 电缆在电缆登陆站处浮出水面。 这些登陆站通常是朴素且安保严密的设施，配有可靠的电力供应。 首选位置是渔业或其他海上交通量较少的海岸点，且从深海海床向上坡度陡峭。 电缆面临的最大风险来自近海航运活动，因此从深海海床到陆上电缆站的距离越短越好。

paragraphs.en: Many jurisdictions also declare ‘Cable Protection Zones’ as a warning to marine vessel operators that there are cables on the seafloor in this area, and ships should refrain from fishing activity and anchoring in these areas.
paragraphs.zh: 许多司法管辖区还宣布设立“电缆保护区”，以警告船舶经营者该区域海床上存在电缆，船只应避免在这些区域进行捕捞活动和抛锚作业。

paragraphs.en: Cable routing is also important in terms of resilience. There are several objectives in a cable route, and not all of them can be optimized at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 在韧性方面，布线路径同样重要。 布线路径中有多个目标，而这些目标无法同时全部得到优化。

paragraphs.en: The cable route should be as short as possible, as additional cable length raises capital costs and increases end-to-end signal delay.
paragraphs.zh: 电缆路径应尽可能短，因为额外的电缆长度会增加资本成本并延长端到端信号延迟。

paragraphs.en: Cables should avoid areas of active geological activity where possible, such as tectonic plate boundaries and mid-plate rifts. Deeper is better, but within reason. Cables on the floor of a deep ocean section are less vulnerable to shipping activity and hostile efforts to disrupt the cable, but with extreme depths it’s more challenging to locate and raise the cable when undertaking a repair.

paragraphs.en: Sometimes there are geographic ‘choke points’ through which many cables are routed. The Bab al-Mandab Strait is not just a choke point for surface vessels passing between the Indian Ocean and the Red Sea, but it is also the conduit through which 16 cables pass (Figure 4). In September 2025, several cables were severed in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, disrupting an estimated 25% of cable capacity between Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. Houthi-controlled waters remain effectively ungovernable for cable protection.
paragraphs.zh: 有时存在地理上的“咽喉要道”，许多海缆都经由这些通道铺设。 曼德海峡不仅是往返于印度洋与红海之间的水面船只的咽喉要道，也是16条海缆经过的通道（图4）。 2025年9月，数条海缆在曼德海峡被切断，估计扰乱了亚洲、欧洲与中东之间25%的海缆容量。 胡塞武装控制的水域在海缆保护方面实际上仍处于无法治理的状态。

paragraphs.en: Further north, between Taiwan and the Philippines is the Luzon Strait, where 18 cables pass (Figure 6). This was the location of an earthquake and a subsequent set of submarine landslides in December 2006 that not only severed all the cables running through this strait, but also buried many of them under deep layers of sediment. It took 11 repair vessels 49 days to bring all the cable systems back into operation.

paragraphs.en: Geopolitics also plays a role in cable routing. Cable owners will prefer to avoid routes through politically unstable territorial waters if suitable alternative routes exist. There are also political considerations. If a cable lands in US territory, then the cable is subject to several Federal Communications Commission (FCC) constraints, including banning equipment or services from companies the FCC see as a threat to US national security. The FCC has also refused to permit the landing of a cable on US territory if the cable also lands in a territory that the US deems to be a foreign adversary.
paragraphs.zh: 地缘政治也会影响海缆的路由选择。 如果存在合适的替代路线，海缆所有者会倾向于避开穿越政治不稳定国家领海的路线。 此外还有政治层面的考量。 如果海缆在美国境内登陆，则该海缆将受到美国联邦通信委员会（FCC）的多项约束，包括禁止使用被 FCC 视为威胁美国国家安全的公司所提供的设备或服务。 如果某条海缆同时在美国所认定外国对手的领土登陆，FCC 也曾拒绝批准该海缆在美国境内登陆。

paragraphs.en: Around 200 submarine cable faults are reported worldwide each year, a figure that the International Cable Protection Committee notes has stayed broadly steady in recent years even as the total cable inventory increases. The cables themselves are remarkably reliable. It is the maritime traffic above them that is the cause of most of the problems. 86% of cable faults are likely due to fishing activity or anchoring, and fishing activity is around twice as prevalent as anchoring incidents.
paragraphs.zh: 全球每年报告约200起海底电缆故障，国际电缆保护委员会指出，尽管电缆总存量不断增加，近年来这一数字基本保持稳定。 电缆本身非常可靠。 造成大多数问题的，是电缆上方的海上交通。86%的电缆故障可能是由捕捞活动或抛锚造成的，而捕捞活动的发生频率约是抛锚事件的两倍。

paragraphs.en: Geological events, such as submarine landslides and seabed movement, account for about 7% of cable faults, cable abrasion for 4%, and component failure (in repeaters) for only 4%.
paragraphs.zh: 地质事件（如海底滑坡和海底移动）约占海缆故障的7%，海缆磨损占4%，而组件故障（发生在中继器中）仅占4%。

paragraphs.en: With the high correlation of faults and maritime activity, it is not surprising that just under one half of cable faults occur in territorial waters, and most of the remainder occur in exclusive economic zones. Just 2% occur on the high seas. Cables are most vulnerable close to shore, in shallow water, where fishing is concentrated, where ships anchor, and where the cable must come ashore at a landing station alongside every other cable serving that coast. The deep ocean, where there is little seabed fishing activity and few ships anchoring, is the safest location for a cable.
paragraphs.zh: 由于故障与海上活动高度相关，将近一半的海缆故障发生在领海内，其余大部分发生在专属经济区内，这并不令人意外。 仅有2%发生在公海。 海缆在近岸浅水区最为脆弱，那里渔业活动集中、船只抛锚，而且海缆必须与其他所有服务于该海岸的海缆一起在登陆站登陆上岸。 深海几乎没有什么海底捕捞活动和抛锚的船只，是海缆最安全的位置。

paragraphs.en: National jurisdictions do not stop at the low tide mark of a territory, they extend out into the sea and the seafloor. The 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (PDF) defined sovereign territorial waters as a 12-mile zone extending out from an economy’s coast. Every coastal economy has exclusive rights to the oil, gas, and other resources in the seabed up to 200 nautical miles from shore or to the outer edge of the continental margin, whichever is the further, subject to an overall limit of 350 nautical miles (650km) from the coast or 100 nautical miles (185km) beyond the 2,500-metre isobath (a line connecting equal points of water depth).
paragraphs.zh: 国家管辖范围并不止于领土的低潮线，而是延伸到海洋和海床之中。 1982年的《联合国海洋法公约》（PDF）将主权领海定义为从经济体海岸向外延伸12海里的区域。 每个沿海经济体对距海岸200海里以内、或大陆边缘外缘（以较远者为准）的海底石油、天然气及其他资源拥有专属权利，但总限度为距海岸350海里（650公里）或超出2500米等深线（连接水深相等点的线）100海里（185公里）。

sents.zh: 国家管辖范围并不止于领土的低潮线，而是延伸到海洋和海床之中。

paragraphs.en: What does this mean for submarine cables? From the point where the cable enters territorial waters, any physical activity related to the cable requires the permission of the authorities. All cable construction and repair operations carried out in these sovereign areas also require the permission of the economy that has exclusive rights to the sea and seafloor.
paragraphs.zh: 这对海底电缆意味着什么？ 从电缆进入领海的那一刻起，任何与电缆相关的实体活动都需要获得有关当局的许可。 在这些主权区域内进行的一切电缆建设和维修作业，也需要获得对该海域和海床拥有专属权利的经济体的许可。

paragraphs.en: Locating a cable break is straightforward. An optical pulse will be reflected at the point of a cable break, which can provide the distance to the fault from the start of the cable with considerable precision. At that point, it becomes a marine operation.
paragraphs.zh: 定位光缆断点非常简单。 光脉冲会在光缆断点处被反射回来，从而能够相当精确地提供从光缆起点到故障点的距离。 到了那一步，就变成一项海上作业了。

paragraphs.en: A specialist cable repair ship must be engaged, which, in turn, must obtain the relevant government’s permission to work at the location of the cable fault (don’t forget that only 2% of outages occur in international waters). Once at the break location, the repair vessel drags a grapnel along the seabed to hook the cable, cuts it, recovers one end, buoys it off, then recovers the other end. A new section is spliced into the cable aboard the ship in a jointing cabin, the fibre fusion-spliced and tested, the joint rebuilt and sealed against pressure, and the repaired cable laid back down with enough slack to reach the seabed.
paragraphs.zh: 必须雇用一艘专业海缆修理船，而该船又必须获得相关政府的许可才能在海缆故障地点作业（别忘了，只有2%的故障发生在国际水域）。 到达断点位置后，修理船沿海底拖曳抓钩以钩住海缆，将其切断，回收一端并用浮标标记，然后再回收另一端。 新的一段海缆在船上的接续舱内被接续到海缆中，光纤进行熔接并测试，接头重建并密封以抗压，最后将修复的海缆重新铺设下去，并留出足够的余量使其能够触及海底。

The industry has roughly 60 ships capable of repairing a submarine cable, operated under maintenance agreements that pool the cost of running this fleet across cable owners in each geographic region. paragraphs.en: Analysis by TeleGeography and Infra-Analytics has found that around two-thirds of cable maintenance vessels will reach the end of their service lives by 2040, while total cable kilometres are projected to grow by about 48% over the same period. Closing that gap would take USD 3B and require fifteen replacement ships plus five additional vessels simply to hold current service levels as the submarine cable network expands. The immediate problem is that nobody obviously owns this bill. Cable maintenance is funded through shared agreements that have been optimized for decades to be as cheap as possible, which worked when the fleet was young and is precisely the wrong structure for financing a fleet renewal.

sents.en: Analysis by TeleGeography and Infra-Analytics has found that around two-thirds of cable maintenance vessels will reach the end of their service lives by 2040, while total cable kilometres are projected to grow by about 48% over the same period.

sents.en: Closing that gap would take USD 3B and require fifteen replacement ships plus five additional vessels simply to hold current service levels as the submarine cable network expands.
sents.zh: 弥补这一缺口需要 30 亿美元，需要十五艘替换船只，外加五艘额外船只，才能在海缆网络扩张的同时维持当前的服务水平。

Adding cable routes is comparatively easy, because today’s hyperscale cloud companies fund much of the new construction themselves and have strong commercial reasons to do so. However, no individual cable is so critical that it can sustain a business case to operate a dedicated repair fleet. The industry uses pooled resources, which suffer from under-investment.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是海缆韧性问题的核心。 增加海缆路由相对容易，因为当今的超大规模云公司自己出资新建了大部分海缆，而且有充分的商业理由这样做。 然而，没有任何一条单独的海缆重要到足以支撑起运营一支专门维修船队的商业案例。 该行业采用资源共享模式，而这种模式长期投资不足。

paragraphs.en: A rundown of recent cable outages includes:
paragraphs.zh: 近期光缆中断事故的概要包括：

paragraphs.en: The outcomes are much less uniform than this list suggests. Swedish authorities found no conclusive evidence of wrongdoing in the Yi Peng 3 case and ruled the January 2025 Latvia-to-Gotland damage accidental. A Finnish court dismissed the case against the Eagle S captain in October 2025. United States and European officials concluded that several of the Baltic incidents were accidental. The captain of the Hong Tai 58 was convicted in Taiwan and sentenced to three years over the Taiwan to Penghu No. 3 cable, and the Newnew Polar Bear captain faced criminal damage charges in Hong Kong. The April 2026 Matsu fault turned out to have been caused by the wreck of a stranded fishing boat shifting onto the cable.
paragraphs.zh: 结果远比这份清单所暗示的更加不一致。 瑞典当局在「 Yi Peng 3 」案中未发现不当行为的确凿证据，并裁定 2025 年 1 月拉脱维亚至哥特兰岛电缆受损为意外事故。 芬兰一家法院于 2025 年 10 月驳回了对「 Eagle S 」船长的案件。 美国和欧洲官员得出结论，波罗的海多起事件属于意外。 「宏泰 58 」船长在台湾因台湾至澎湖 3 号电缆案被定罪并判处三年有期徒刑，而「 Newnew Polar Bear 」船长在香港面临刑事毁坏指控。 2026 年 4 月的马祖电缆故障最终查明是由一艘搁浅渔船的残骸移位压到电缆所致。

sents.en: The outcomes are much less uniform than this list suggests.
sents.zh: 结果远比这份清单所暗示的更加不一致。

sents.en: Swedish authorities found no conclusive evidence of wrongdoing in the Yi Peng 3 case and ruled the January 2025 Latvia-to-Gotland damage accidental.
sents.zh: 瑞典当局在「 Yi Peng 3 」案中未发现不当行为的确凿证据，并裁定 2025 年 1 月拉脱维亚至哥特兰岛电缆受损为意外事故。

sents.en: A Finnish court dismissed the case against the Eagle S captain in October 2025.
sents.zh: 芬兰一家法院于 2025 年 10 月驳回了对「 Eagle S 」船长的案件。

sents.en: United States and European officials concluded that several of the Baltic incidents were accidental.
sents.zh: 美国和欧洲官员得出结论，波罗的海多起事件属于意外。

sents.en: The captain of the Hong Tai 58 was convicted in Taiwan and sentenced to three years over the Taiwan to Penghu No. 3 cable, and the Newnew Polar Bear captain faced criminal damage charges in Hong Kong.
sents.zh: 「宏泰 58 」船长在台湾因台湾至澎湖 3 号电缆案被定罪并判处三年有期徒刑，而「 Newnew Polar Bear 」船长在香港面临刑事毁坏指控。

sents.en: The April 2026 Matsu fault turned out to have been caused by the wreck of a stranded fishing boat shifting onto the cable.
sents.zh: 2026 年 4 月的马祖电缆故障最终查明是由一艘搁浅渔船的残骸移位压到电缆所致。

paragraphs.en: Anchor dragging is a common occurrence, particularly among poorly maintained merchant vessels in bad weather, accounting for a large share of ordinary faults every year. This may explain why investigators keep reaching inconclusive findings in good faith.
paragraphs.zh: 走锚是一种常见现象，尤其是在恶劣天气中维护不善的商船上，每年在一般性事故中占很大比例。 这或许可以解释为什么调查人员一直出于善意却得出没有定论的结论。

sents.en: Anchor dragging is a common occurrence, particularly among poorly maintained merchant vessels in bad weather, accounting for a large share of ordinary faults every year.
sents.zh: 走锚是一种常见现象，尤其是在恶劣天气中维护不善的商船上，每年在一般性事故中占很大比例。

sents.en: This may explain why investigators keep reaching inconclusive findings in good faith.
sents.zh: 这或许可以解释为什么调查人员一直出于善意却得出没有定论的结论。

paragraphs.en: Cable systems have changed in recent decades.
paragraphs.zh: 近几十年来，有线系统发生了变化。

paragraphs.en: The old telephone system regarded each cable as a self-contained system. The cable owner was responsible for its own resilience, independent of any other cables that may exist on similar routes. The telephone’s data carriage system typically used a ring architecture, where any outage in the ring caused the traffic to flow along the other half of the ring. If the ring used diverse paths, then any individual outage in the ring could be repaired immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 旧式电话系统将每条电缆视为一个自成一体的系统。 电缆所有者负责自身的韧性，而不依赖于可能存在于相似路线上的任何其他电缆。 电话的数据传输系统通常采用环形架构，环上的任何中断都会导致流量沿着环的另一半流动。 如果该环采用多样化的路径，那么环上的任何单点中断都可以立即修复。

sents.en: The old telephone system regarded each cable as a self-contained system.
sents.zh: 旧式电话系统将每条电缆视为一个自成一体的系统。

sents.en: The cable owner was responsible for its own resilience, independent of any other cables that may exist on similar routes.
sents.zh: 电缆所有者负责自身的韧性，而不依赖于可能存在于相似路线上的任何其他电缆。

sents.en: The telephone’s data carriage system typically used a ring architecture, where any outage in the ring caused the traffic to flow along the other half of the ring.
sents.zh: 电话的数据传输系统通常采用环形架构，环上的任何中断都会导致流量沿着环的另一半流动。

sents.en: If the ring used diverse paths, then any individual outage in the ring could be repaired immediately.
sents.zh: 如果该环采用多样化的路径，那么环上的任何单点中断都可以立即修复。

paragraphs.en: However, the implication of this design was that the actual capacity of the system was double the usable capacity. The cost of using such a cable reflected this 50% carriage efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种设计的含义是系统的实际容量是可用容量的两倍。 使用这种线缆的成本反映了这 50% 的传输效率。

sents.en: However, the implication of this design was that the actual capacity of the system was double the usable capacity.
sents.zh: 然而，这种设计的含义是系统的实际容量是可用容量的两倍。

sents.en: The cost of using such a cable reflected this 50% carriage efficiency.
sents.zh: 使用这种线缆的成本反映了这 50% 的传输效率。

paragraphs.en: In their search for cheaper services, Internet Service Providers (ISPs) wanted to purchase non-backed-up cable capacity, at a price that reflected this greater efficiency of cable use. They purchased this cheaper form of cable capacity on multiple cable systems. Individual outages caused a break in that cable’s service, but the ISP could reroute their traffic to use capacity that had been purchased on other cable systems which were not affected by the outage. For Internet traffic, this failover function is readily achieved in the routing system.
paragraphs.zh: 在寻求更廉价服务的过程中，互联网服务提供商（ISP）希望购买无需备份的电缆容量，其价格应反映电缆使用的这种更高效率。 他们在多条电缆系统上购买了这种更廉价的电缆容量。 单个故障会导致该电缆的服务中断，但 ISP 可以将流量重新路由到在其他未受故障影响的电缆系统上购买的容量。 对于互联网流量而言，这种故障转移功能可以很容易地在路由系统中实现。

sents.en: In their search for cheaper services, Internet Service Providers (ISPs) wanted to purchase non-backed-up cable capacity, at a price that reflected this greater efficiency of cable use.
sents.zh: 在寻求更廉价服务的过程中，互联网服务提供商（ISP）希望购买无需备份的电缆容量，其价格应反映电缆使用的这种更高效率。

sents.en: They purchased this cheaper form of cable capacity on multiple cable systems.
sents.zh: 他们在多条电缆系统上购买了这种更廉价的电缆容量。

sents.en: Individual outages caused a break in that cable’s service, but the ISP could reroute their traffic to use capacity that had been purchased on other cable systems which were not affected by the outage.
sents.zh: 单个故障会导致该电缆的服务中断，但 ISP 可以将流量重新路由到在其他未受故障影响的电缆系统上购买的容量。

sents.en: For Internet traffic, this failover function is readily achieved in the routing system.
sents.zh: 对于互联网流量而言，这种故障转移功能可以很容易地在路由系统中实现。

paragraphs.en: The overall outcome was that the responsibility for resilience shifted from the individual cable operator to the network operator. Cable outages would still cause a drop in available capacity. But as most Internet traffic is elastic, the drop in capacity would cause a drop in performance but not cause a complete shutdown.
paragraphs.zh: 总体结果是，韧性（弹性）责任从各个线缆运营商转移到了网络运营商身上。 线缆中断仍然会导致可用容量的下降。 但由于大多数互联网流量是弹性的，容量的下降只会导致性能下降，而不会造成完全停摆。

sents.en: The overall outcome was that the responsibility for resilience shifted from the individual cable operator to the network operator.
sents.zh: 总体结果是，韧性（弹性）责任从各个线缆运营商转移到了网络运营商身上。

sents.en: Cable outages would still cause a drop in available capacity.
sents.zh: 线缆中断仍然会导致可用容量的下降。

sents.en: But as most Internet traffic is elastic, the drop in capacity would cause a drop in performance but not cause a complete shutdown.
sents.zh: 但由于大多数互联网流量是弹性的，容量的下降只会导致性能下降，而不会造成完全停摆。

paragraphs.en: Submarine cable systems are built by private consortia, repaired by private contracts that collectively fund a commercial repair fleet, regulated by coastal states individually, and governed internationally by international conventions drafted long before the Internet existed.
paragraphs.zh: 海底电缆系统由私人财团建造，由私人合同（这些合同共同资助一支商业修理船队）进行维修，由各沿海国家单独监管，并在国际层面上由早在互联网出现之前就已起草的国际公约加以治理。

paragraphs.en: It would be good if permissions to repair submarine cables were granted in a streamlined manner so that repairs were not stalled for months awaiting a government’s approval to operate in their waters. It would be even better if emergency procedures were agreed in advance rather than negotiated during an outage.
paragraphs.zh: 如果海缆修理的许可能够以简化的方式获批，使修理工作不会因等待某国政府批准进入其水域而拖延数月，那将是好事。 如果应急程序能够提前商定，而不是在中断发生时才临时协商，那就更好了。

sents.en: It would be good if permissions to repair submarine cables were granted in a streamlined manner so that repairs were not stalled for months awaiting a government’s approval to operate in their waters.
sents.zh: 如果海缆修理的许可能够以简化的方式获批，使修理工作不会因等待某国政府批准进入其水域而拖延数月，那将是好事。

sents.en: It would be even better if emergency procedures were agreed in advance rather than negotiated during an outage.
sents.zh: 如果应急程序能够提前商定，而不是在中断发生时才临时协商，那就更好了。

paragraphs.en: Collectively, the industry needs to invest in repair capacity to upgrade an ageing repair fleet. Who undertakes this investment and how the repair capability is managed as a common asset is proving to be a difficult issue. In the worst case, it will be back to every cable for itself, and the inevitable outcome of higher costs and potentially slower repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 整体而言，行业需要投资于维修能力，以升级老化的维修船队。 由谁来承担这项投资，以及如何将维修能力作为一项公共资产来管理，正成为一个难题。 在最坏的情况下，将退回到每条海缆各自为政的局面，其必然结果是成本更高，维修也可能更慢。

sents.en: Collectively, the industry needs to invest in repair capacity to upgrade an ageing repair fleet.
sents.zh: 整体而言，行业需要投资于维修能力，以升级老化的维修船队。

sents.en: Who undertakes this investment and how the repair capability is managed as a common asset is proving to be a difficult issue.
sents.zh: 由谁来承担这项投资，以及如何将维修能力作为一项公共资产来管理，正成为一个难题。

sents.en: In the worst case, it will be back to every cable for itself, and the inevitable outcome of higher costs and potentially slower repairs.
sents.zh: 在最坏的情况下，将退回到每条海缆各自为政的局面，其必然结果是成本更高，维修也可能更慢。

paragraphs.en: Geographic choke points will persist, geology will not stop, extreme weather and changing sediment conditions will continue to pose a threat to these cables. Route diversity is an effective response to these challenges, but economic clustering works against cable route diversity. Each cable would like to run through the shortest and cheapest route, and no cable operator is specifically motivated to spend additional sums to take a diverse route to the other existing cables.
paragraphs.zh: 地理咽喉要道将持续存在，地质条件不会停止变化，极端天气和泥沙状况的改变将继续对这些海缆构成威胁。 路由多样化是应对这些挑战的有效手段，但经济集聚效应却不利于海缆路由的多样化。 每条海缆都希望走最短、最便宜的路由，没有任何海缆运营商有特别的动机去花费额外的资金，选择一条与其他现有海缆不同的多样化路由。

sents.en: Geographic choke points will persist, geology will not stop, extreme weather and changing sediment conditions will continue to pose a threat to these cables.
sents.zh: 地理咽喉要道将持续存在，地质条件不会停止变化，极端天气和泥沙状况的改变将继续对这些海缆构成威胁。

sents.en: Route diversity is an effective response to these challenges, but economic clustering works against cable route diversity.
sents.zh: 路由多样化是应对这些挑战的有效手段，但经济集聚效应却不利于海缆路由的多样化。

sents.en: Each cable would like to run through the shortest and cheapest route, and no cable operator is specifically motivated to spend additional sums to take a diverse route to the other existing cables.
sents.zh: 每条海缆都希望走最短、最便宜的路由，没有任何海缆运营商有特别的动机去花费额外的资金，选择一条与其他现有海缆不同的多样化路由。

paragraphs.en: None of this is technologically difficult, but it can be institutionally and economically difficult, which is harder.
paragraphs.zh: 这些都没有技术上的困难，但在制度上和经济上可能很困难，而这更难。

paragraphs.en: The telephone company consortium model that funded and operated almost all the world’s subsea cables 30 years ago has come to an end. The service life of the entire inventory of cables and service vessels that they operated is also coming to an end.
paragraphs.zh: 三十年前，资助并运营全球几乎所有海底光缆的电话公司联合体模式已经终结。 他们所运营的全部光缆和作业船船队的使用寿命也即将走到尽头。

sents.en: The telephone company consortium model that funded and operated almost all the world’s subsea cables 30 years ago has come to an end.
sents.zh: 三十年前，资助并运营全球几乎所有海底光缆的电话公司联合体模式已经终结。

sents.en: The service life of the entire inventory of cables and service vessels that they operated is also coming to an end.
sents.zh: 他们所运营的全部光缆和作业船船队的使用寿命也即将走到尽头。

paragraphs.en: Approximately a quarter of the world’s current subsea cable kilometres are projected to be decommissioned and retired by 2030. This massive retirement of capacity amounts to 845,000 kilometres of subsea fibre-optic cables at the end-of-life cycle for submarine infrastructure laid during the massive Internet boom of the late 1990s and early 2000s. Specifically, TAT-8 and TAT-14 in the Atlantic Ocean are being decommissioned, SEA-ME-WE-3, linking Europe and Asia, has been retired, and Japan-US and China-US have ended operations. In addition, more than half of the current repair vessel fleet will have reached their retirement point by 2040.
paragraphs.zh: 预计到2030年，全球目前约四分之一的海底电缆里程将被停用和退役。 这次大规模的容量退役相当于845,000公里的海底光纤电缆，这些电缆是在1990年代末和2000年代初互联网大繁荣期间铺设的海底基础设施，现已到达生命周期终点。 具体而言，大西洋中的TAT-8和TAT-14正在被停用，连接欧洲与亚洲的SEA-ME-WE-3已经退役，Japan-US和China-US也已停止运营。 此外，超过一半的现有修理船队将在2040年前达到退役时点。

sents.en: Approximately a quarter of the world’s current subsea cable kilometres are projected to be decommissioned and retired by 2030.
sents.zh: 预计到2030年，全球目前约四分之一的海底电缆里程将被停用和退役。

sents.en: This massive retirement of capacity amounts to 845,000 kilometres of subsea fibre-optic cables at the end-of-life cycle for submarine infrastructure laid during the massive Internet boom of the late 1990s and early 2000s.
sents.zh: 这次大规模的容量退役相当于845,000公里的海底光纤电缆，这些电缆是在1990年代末和2000年代初互联网大繁荣期间铺设的海底基础设施，现已到达生命周期终点。

sents.en: Specifically, TAT-8 and TAT-14 in the Atlantic Ocean are being decommissioned, SEA-ME-WE-3, linking Europe and Asia, has been retired, and Japan-US and China-US have ended operations.
sents.zh: 具体而言，大西洋中的TAT-8和TAT-14正在被停用，连接欧洲与亚洲的SEA-ME-WE-3已经退役，Japan-US和China-US也已停止运营。

sents.en: In addition, more than half of the current repair vessel fleet will have reached their retirement point by 2040.
sents.zh: 此外，超过一半的现有修理船队将在2040年前达到退役时点。

paragraphs.en: In their place are cable projects that are either fully funded or partially funded by the current US digital giants. This raises sovereign risk eyebrows in many economies, where the only communications conduits for an economy are owned and operated by a foreign entity. It also raises the question of sovereign control over the submarine repair vessel fleet and the existing maintenance pooling arrangements through submarine cable maintenance zones.
paragraphs.zh: 取而代之的是由当前美国数字巨头全额资助或部分资助的电缆项目。 这在许多经济体中引发了主权风险的担忧，因为这些经济体唯一的通信通道由外国实体拥有和运营。 这也提出了对海底修理船船队的主权控制问题，以及通过海底电缆维护区现有的联合维护安排的问题。

sents.en: In their place are cable projects that are either fully funded or partially funded by the current US digital giants.
sents.zh: 取而代之的是由当前美国数字巨头全额资助或部分资助的电缆项目。

sents.en: This raises sovereign risk eyebrows in many economies, where the only communications conduits for an economy are owned and operated by a foreign entity.
sents.zh: 这在许多经济体中引发了主权风险的担忧，因为这些经济体唯一的通信通道由外国实体拥有和运营。

sents.en: It also raises the question of sovereign control over the submarine repair vessel fleet and the existing maintenance pooling arrangements through submarine cable maintenance zones.
sents.zh: 这也提出了对海底修理船船队的主权控制问题，以及通过海底电缆维护区现有的联合维护安排的问题。

paragraphs.en: By 2028, Google will own the largest set of cables, measured by kilometres, in the Pacific, Atlantic and Indian Oceans, and based on current plans it will have more than 50% of the entire cable inventory under its control in the Indo-Pacific region. Similar centralization scenarios are playing out in the Atlantic Ocean as well. At this point, the sovereign risk eyebrows should be hitting the ceiling, as such a dominant position gives this single company unilateral control over the maintenance arrangements and associated repair vessel operations for the entire world’s communications network.
paragraphs.zh: 到2028年，按公里数衡量，谷歌将拥有太平洋、大西洋和印度洋中规模最大的海缆网络，并且根据目前的计划，它将控制整个印太地区超过50%的海缆总量。 类似的集中化情形也在大西洋上演。 至此，主权风险的警报应该已经拉到最高级别，因为如此主导性的地位使这一家公司能够单方面控制全球通信网络的维护安排以及相关的维修船作业。

paragraphs.en: This is a serious issue for us, both as individuals and societally as we try to preserve the integrity and utility of our common communications infrastructure. The stability and productivity of our societies rely on our ability to communicate with each other seamlessly, efficiently and privately.

paragraphs.en: Passing the investment and operational costs of the public telecommunications services from public to private hands in the latter part of the 20th century was seen as a smart move. The move used private finance to fund the reinvigoration of national telecommunications infrastructure as it shifted from time-based voice switching to a far larger packet switching architecture to support computer-mediated communications and service provision.
paragraphs.zh: 20世纪后期，将公共电信服务的投资和运营成本由公共部门转移到私人部门被视为明智之举。 这一举措利用私人资金为国内电信基础设施的振兴提供资金，使其从基于时间的语音交换转向规模大得多的分组交换架构，以支持计算机中介的通信与服务提供。

paragraphs.en: However, we may see more uncomfortable outcomes looming in the near future. It was thought that the discipline of competition would rein in the potential abuses by private operators of the privileged position of operating a public communications service. That is not what happened.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，我们可能会看到更多令人不安的后果在不久的将来浮现。 人们曾认为，竞争的约束力会遏制私营运营商利用运营公共通信服务的特权地位可能产生的滥用行为。 但事情并没有这样发展。

paragraphs.en: Not only are public telecommunications systems now largely in private hands, but we are also seeing consolidation of the global telecommunications system to a few private entities, with no competition. Their accountability is not to the public or users of the service. Their accountability is to their institutional investors to continually improve their value and profitability. Nothing else.
paragraphs.zh: 公用电信系统如今不仅大部分已落入私人手中，我们还看到全球电信系统正在整合为少数几家私人实体，毫无竞争可言。 它们不对公众或服务的使用者负责。 它们只对机构投资者负责，要不断提升其价值与盈利能力。仅此而已。

paragraphs.en: So where does this leave the submarine cable system and efforts to maintain its critical function with the appropriate levels of resilience that reflect their critical role in global communications? Outside the US, few individual economies, if any, have the resources to meaningfully respond to this challenge. The European Union (EU) has taken some action to contribute to funding a fleet of repair vessels and taken measures to improve surveillance on submarine cables as a matter of regional security, but no other economies appear to be following this lead. It would certainly be ironic if this EU money were to end up simply funding the maintenance of Google’s submarine cable assets!
paragraphs.zh: 那么，这对海底电缆系统以及为保持其关键功能所需的适当韧性水平的努力又意味着什么呢？这种韧性水平应当与其在全球通信中的关键作用相匹配。 在美国之外，几乎没有哪个单一经济体拥有足够的资源来有效应对这一挑战。 欧盟（EU）已采取一些行动，出资组建一支维修船队，并采取措施加强海底电缆监控，将其作为区域安全事务，但似乎没有其他经济体跟进这一做法。 如果这些欧盟资金最终只是用来维护谷歌的海底电缆资产，那可真是莫大的讽刺！
